title: Yellow Spicy Korean Sevaiiya Noodles
description: A spicy and crunchy one-pot Korean dish featuring sevaiiya, made in a robata-grill vessel with sous-vide technique, this kosher-friendly meal is perfect for dinner
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill vessel to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a bowl, whisk together gochujang sauce, sesame oil, crushed garlic, grated ginger, salt, and black pepper
Add the sevaiiya noodles to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce mixture
Add the sliced green onions and toasted sesame seeds to the bowl and toss to combine
Add the water to the robata-grill vessel and bring to a boil
Add the noodle mixture to the vessel and cook for 10 minutes with the lid on
Use the sous-vide technique to cook the noodles at 190 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes
Remove the lid and stir-fry the noodles for 2 minutes
